cpu: Repeated frozen probe request: parse/validate closed input and nominal constraints, named read returns a copied trusted in-memory fixture row asynchronously, core validates row, projects title and executes authored outcome match. No timer or actual database I/O. Include all host codecs and Wasm instantiation. This is boundary/control-flow work, not a synthetic Rust-only algorithm.
io: Same probe and encoded request, real isolated SQLite authority with owner-bound predicate and parameter values; validate returned row and produce same alpha outcome. No artificial delay. Include entire operation and host serialization.
order: Alternate Bun/Wasm starting target by run index; run targets sequentially to avoid competing throughput loops.

serialization.procedure: Choose ASCII optional-note length so the complete JSON input frame, including property names and UUID/title, is exactly the stated byte length. Measure the complete CPU probe for each size plus encode/decode/copy paths separately. A size limit rejection is an error, never successful throughput.

errors: Check every response kind/value and count errors separately; any semantic mismatch fails the workload.
latencies: Record per-request elapsed milliseconds including await and copies; p50/p95/p99, success count/seconds, per-run RSS where observable. Run sample medians/ranges; no significance claim from request count.
interpretation: Fixed one-instance-per-request experiment ABI includes its allocation cost. No general claim about optimized pooling, all Wasm code, or remote storage follows. Cloud timings separate from local causal comparison.
